_note: Curated (T2c). Only E (Dazzle) deals damage; Q is a heal, W an armor buff, R an invulnerability. E's TotalDamage = EffectValueCalculationPart + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart (x2, AD and armor scaling) -- both kinds FormulaInterpreter fully supports, so this resolves live.
_noteP: P (Bravado): every 3rd consecutive spell-cast or basic attack empowers Taric's next attack to deal bonus magic damage plus armor scaling (TaricPassive.mSpellCalculations 'TotalDamage' = ProductOfSubPartsCalculationPart(ByCharLevelInterpolationCalculationPart(mStartValue=25.0..mEndValue=93.0) x NamedDataValueCalculationPart(mDataValue='BaseDamageMultiplierForModesBalance', flat 1.0 at every rank in Summoner's Rift BIN data)) + StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart(mStat=1/mStatFormula=2, mDataValue='ArmorDamageValue', flat 0.15 at every rank). RESOLVED: ChampionBinParser.ParseSubParts now also reads the 'mPart1'/'mPart2' fixed-field shape this ProductOfSubPartsCalculationPart uses (confirmed via direct BIN inspection: taric.bin.json's SumOfSubPartsCalculationPart nodes always use 'mSubparts', while every ProductOfSubPartsCalculationPart -- both here and nested inside TaricPassive's own 'CDR' calc -- uses 'mPart1'/'mPart2' instead), so the product no longer silently collapses to a bogus 1.0. Since BaseDamageMultiplierForModesBalance is flat 1.0, the product term evaluates to just the interpolated 25 (level 1) .. 93 (level 18) value; plus 0.15x armor. Hand-verified: level 1 = 25 + 0.15*armor, level 18 = 93 + 0.15*armor (see ChampionBinTests.FormulaInterpreter_Evaluate_TaricPassive_ResolvesProductOfSubPartsMPart1MPart2Shape). Modeled as a P bonusEffect trigger onHit (same conditional-proc style as Sejuani/Volibear/Nocturne P; the every-3rd-hit gating is not modeled, approximated as firing on every attack).
